notes.title: Patch notes 23/12/2017
notes.notes:
Patch notes 23/12/2017

This patch contains mostly bug fixes, as well as improved controls for the boat. New levels and features will be coming early January 2018!

Gameplay

 Changed the way controlling the boat in the road map works. It should be a lot easier to navigate.
 Added more decoration to certain levels.


Bug fixes

 Players can't throw children into cannons while the children are not near you.
 Fixed accidental spawn point locations breaking certain levels.
 Increased the size of the water level meter in the UI to make it more visible.
 Made it easier to cross bridges for both players and fruit children.
 Players won't get pushed through fences by the evil cucumbers anymore.
 Removed the random chance to instantly drown at the start of level 2.
 The campfire in level 3 no longer burns underwater.
